answer: Tenure accrues per cluster, not per head, so clones share one clock. The haven is a registry that merges identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster, which earns one marble per epoch, a marble being one epoch of attested honest operation. A reef, one claimed identity ranked k-th in its cluster, votes only after k² marble are spent seating it. Attacker's price: one honest reef waits 1 epoch, while 100 reefs wait 338,350 epochs. Clones that the haven fails to merge break it.
